hero.title: EternalSystem
hero.tagline: Bans, mutes, reports & video-style replays — one stack, one DB, one build.
hero.description: A complete moderation platform for CloudNet networks, built for server owners who want to give their staff the best tooling without juggling half a dozen plugins.

why.title: Why EternalSystem?
why.subtitle: Because moderation shouldn't be spread across five different plugins.

allInOne.title: All-in-One
allInOne.body: Bans, mutes, reports, replays, web dashboard, permission management, GDPR compliance — one stack, one DB, one build.

replay.title: Real replay system
replay.body: Staff watch the incident as a video — real player models, skins, animations. No live-TP, no guesswork.

network.title: Network-ready
network.body: Bungee + Spigot 1.19 with CloudNet V3 integration. Works standalone too — CloudNet is not required.

gdpr.title: GDPR-compliant
gdpr.body: Privacy consent on first join, right-to-be-erased via admin panel, audit log on every moderation action.

highlights.title: The flagship features
highlights.subtitle: What sets EternalSystem apart from a classic ban plugin.

replay.title: Video-style replay system
replay.body: The recorder runs in the background, capturing 60 s of movement, hits, chat, block edits and inventory snapshots per player. When a mod accepts a report, they drop straight into the replay — spectator mode, ProtocolLib fake-players with real skins, hotbar controls for play/pause/seek/exit. Skins are stored inside the replay file, so the mod sees the offender exactly the way they looked at the time of the incident.
bullets: 20 Hz movement tracking (full server-tick resolution) + event-driven hits/chat/edits
Mojang-signed skin storage per replay (codec v2)
ProtocolLib fake-players with walking animations
Per-reason auto-cleanup (permanent ban = kept forever)

reports.title: In-game GUI report system
reports.body: /report opens a chest inventory with configurable item icons per reason. Click → report goes out, recorder freezes the last 60 s, all staff get a cross-server notification. Mod accepts in the web → auto-login in-game + TP into the replay.
bullets: GUI items configurable per reasons.yml (material + slot)
15 default reasons, fully extensible
Cross-server plugin-message bridge between Bungee + Spigot
Auto-close on ban, replay lifecycle with cross-linking

dashboard.title: Angular web dashboard
dashboard.body: Any number of roles — every CloudNet group automatically becomes a web role, plus per-user overrides from the admin panel. Admins decide live in the web which mod can use which ban reasons, which reports they may handle, which sections they see at all. Material design, dark theme with Eternal-pink accents, fully responsive.
bullets: Any number of roles — CloudNet groups mapped automatically
Live active-session monitor for admins
Shortening templates for unban appeals
Clickable player names with rank display across the app

permissions.title: Granular permission engine
permissions.body: No more fixed PLAYER/MOD/ADMIN roles: as many roles as you have CloudNet groups, plus individual per-user overrides. In the dashboard's admin panel you decide live which mod can use which ban reasons, who handles which reports, who can rewatch which replays. Changes propagate straight back into Minecraft.
bullets: Any number of roles from CloudNet groups — no fixed MOD/ADMIN split
User overrides: deny or grant a permission to one specific mod
Reason-scoped keys (eternal.ban.reason.<id>) — fine-grained control
Admin panel in the web dashboard for live editing
Changes propagate back into Minecraft via the CloudNet API

gdpr.title: Privacy consent on first join
gdpr.body: New players see a prompt with clickable accept/decline buttons. Nothing is stored before they answer — no profile, no session, no replay buffer. Decline kicks + purges any data we already had, including the CloudNet user record.
bullets: Movement / chat / build are blocked until they answer
Replay recorder skips non-consenting players
Decline deletes the CloudNet user via reflection (CN3 + CN4)
Audit trail in eternal_consent including IP address

punishments.title: Bans, mutes & escalation ladder
punishments.body: Standard /ban + /mute with numeric reason IDs, tier protection (admin protected from mod), admin-only reasons, escalation ladder (1st / 2nd / 3rd offense = different durations), /modify for after-the-fact adjustments, /resethistory with audit log.
bullets: DurationParser (1d / 6h / 30m / permanent)
Escalation ladder per reason configurable
Vanilla command override for /ban and /pardon
Clickable issuer names with rank display in history

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.subtitle: Six Maven modules, one stack, one database.

core.title: eternal-core
core.body: Shared models, storage layer, services. No Bukkit/Bungee dependency.

spigot.title: eternal-spigot
spigot.body: Bukkit plugin with in-game commands, listeners, report GUI, replay bridge.

bungee.title: eternal-bungee
bungee.body: BungeeCord plugin with proxy-level commands, kicks, cross-server broadcasts.

api.title: eternal-api
api.body: Javalin REST service. Auth via MC-account link or API key.

replay.title: eternal-replay
replay.body: Standalone replay plugin. ProtocolLib NPCs, gzipped binary format.

web.title: eternal-web
web.body: Angular 17 dashboard. Material + Tailwind, dynamic role system from CloudNet groups.

party.title: eternal-party
party.body: Party + friends + base system (homes/warps/teleport), Spigot + proxy.

items.a: Currently Spigot/Paper 1.19. Java 17 is required. A later version is on the roadmap, but 1.19 stays LTS-supported.
No. CloudNet is optional — when present, permissions and groups are auto-synced. Without it you assign eternal.* permissions manually.

items.q: Do I have to install ProtocolLib?
items.a: Optional. With ProtocolLib you get real fake-player NPCs in replay with skin + walking animation. Without it, ArmorStands with player-head spawn as fallback.

items.q: Does it work on a single server?
items.a: Yes. Both Spigot-standalone and Bungee+Spigot are supported. A few features (cross-server broadcasts, plugin-message bridge) need Bungee, but core moderation runs everywhere.

We store personal data only after explicit consent on first join. Decline purges everything including the CloudNet entry. Moderation history is kept on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) legitimate interest.
Yes. Update duration depends on the license tier — Starter 1 year, Pro 2 years, Network lifetime.
